answer_1.quote: Symbolic song composition aims to generate the vocal track of a song as a sequence of symbols representing lyrics and melodies.
answer_1.outputs: Symbolic song representations including lyrics and melodies

answer_2.quote: For objective metrics, we measure melody and lyric generation in three folds respectively. ... For assessing the similarity between the generated melodies and the groundtruth, we adopt the metrics proposed by Song-MASS: Pitch Distribution Similarity (PD), Duration Distribution Similarity (DD), and Melody Distance (MD). Besides, we propose a recall rate to assess the repetition capability... Lyric Generation. We evaluate the similarity between generated and original lyrics using three metrics... CoSENT... ROUGE-2 score... BERT score (BS)...

answer_4.quote: For the subjective evaluation, we conduct a user study in which 30 participants assessed 10 instances for each task.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated generated samples on a scale of 1 to 5 for two metrics per task: Harmony and Melody-Lyric Compatibility for Lyric-to-Melody Generation; Fluency and Melody-Lyric Compatibility for Melody-to-Lyric Generation; Overall Quality and Coherence to Song Prompt for Song Continuation; Overall Quality and Relevance to Text Input for Text-to-Song Generation.
